podcast.title: Charity Origin
podcast.body: The project began as a charity initiative at the National Library of New York in 2010, aiming to raise awareness and foster the proliferation of protected marine areas, particularly for whales. This collaborative effort between Björk and Dirty Projectors was initially envisioned as a single song but evolved into a full album for the cause. "Ella se junto con varias artistas y entre ellos uno con el que ya había colaborado puntualmente a algunas ocasiones que llegaron a los irte proyectos."

podcast.title: Collector's Vinyl Edition
podcast.body: The vinyl edition of the collaborative album, released a year after its digital debut, is a highly sought-after item for collectors. Many fans are unaware of the project's existence, and even fewer know about its limited vinyl release. It features a unique 3D cover, was sold exclusively in independent stores, and is strictly numbered, such as edition 1,040. "Este en concreto es la edición, 1.040. Entonces si se es muy fan de viores y es nuestro coleccionismo, esa es una piza que os puede dar mucho que farrar cuando la enseñé."

podcast.title: Whale Sound Imitation
podcast.body: Dirty Projectors contributed to the album's unique sound by creating rhythmic foundations using drum machines and incorporating vocal improvisations that imitated whale sounds. This experimental vocal technique drew comparisons to Björk's work on her album *Medúlla*. "Los hip-hop proyectos hacen una especie de primeras bases de fondo con espécie de cajas de ritmos pero sigan así mismo emitando como ruidos de gallenas y jugando con su voz un poco como ya hacía en los hígios de ver vuelta."
